notes.title: LAST MAGE - Official Announcement Trailer
notes.notes:
Greetings, wanderers of the arcane,

We’re thrilled to finally reveal the [b]official announcement trailer for Last Mage[/b], our next big upcoming title after Hero Tale!

[previewyoutube=Oqx6L3TG1UY;full][/previewyoutube]

In Last Mage, you’ll dive deep into cursed dungeons, tailor your perfect backpack, wield powerful spells, and uncover ancient magical artifacts. This is a roguelite, spell-based bullet heaven experience, where every decision matters and survival is far from guaranteed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280373/f15859e978edadb6f97fca081d97a2a7d6d52e8b.png[/img]

All of this takes place in a world that has turned its back on magic — and you're the last one left to carry the flame.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280373/b1124668ebb6326c352338350e72c5267a587c20.png[/img]

🛒 [b]Wishlist now on Steam, and be among the first to know about beta tests, demo dates, and more!
[/b]
Stay tuned — this is just the beginning.
